اختمروا (form VIII)
# اِخْتَمَرُوا (iḵtamarū) /ix.ta.ma.ruː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِخْتَمَرَ (iḵtamara)
# اِخْتَمِرُوا (iḵtamirū) /ix.ta.mi.ruː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِخْتَمَرَ (iḵtamara)
